tolerance.derivation: IPOPT 3.14.18 gradient-based scaling with no x scaling: scaled problem min df*f s.t. dc*c, dd*d. The scaled stationarity test is ||df*grad f + sum dc_i lam~_i grad c_i - z~||_inf / s_d <= tol. Unscaled multipliers lam_i = lam~_i dc_i / df, z = z~/df, so the scaled residual equals df * ||grad L||_inf (unscaled). Hence the unscaled stationarity tolerance is tol * s_d / df. IPOPT also requires the unscaled ||grad L|| <= dual_inf_tol (default 1, not set here), which is looser whenever tol * s_d / df < 1.
